text:
#!name=中国人保
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0696 / 中国人保 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0114 / 中国人保去广告 / Sliverkiss[https://github.com/Sliverkiss]

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/zgrb\.epicc\.com\.cn\/G-HAPP\/h\/headlines\/queryHeadlines/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/zgrb\.epicc\.com\.cn\/G-HAPP\/a\/update\/startupPage\/v/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/zgrb\.epicc\.com\.cn\/G-HAPP\/a\/config\/guessYouLike\/v/i then reject_dict(200)
^https:\/\/zgrb\.epicc\.com\.cn\/G-HAPP\/h\/headlines\/queryHeadlines - reject

[Script]
移除主页推广 = type=http-response, pattern=^https:\/\/zgrb\.epicc\.com\.cn\/G-HAPP\/a\/config\/homeInit\/v3, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/PICC_Insurance/PICC_Insurance_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true
移除我的页面推广 = type=http-response, pattern=^https:\/\/zgrb\.epicc\.com\.cn\/G-HAPP\/mpageconfig\/myPageConfigList\/v3, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/PICC_Insurance/PICC_Insurance_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true

[Map Local]
^https:\/\/zgrb\.epicc\.com\.cn\/G-HAPP\/a\/update\/startupPage\/v1 data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/zgrb\.epicc\.com\.cn\/G-HAPP\/a\/config\/guessYouLike\/v3 data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% zgrb.epicc.com.cn
